brief: Enter (29.63024, -89.95027) for Priority 1, closest to 9 isolated buildings [F3]. Enter (29.63125, -89.95027) for Priority 2, closest to 8 isolated buildings [F4]. Enter (29.63390, -89.95065) for Priority 3, closest to 5 isolated buildings [F5]. Enter (29.63504, -89.95027) for Priority 4, closest to 2 isolated buildings [F6]. 105 road pieces were checked: 81 judged flooded, 24 uncertain, rest judged dry [F1]. Buildings: 26 isolated, 1 uncertain, 0 still reachable, 13 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. Testing on 5 SpaceNet 8 tiles, none of the 27 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable, but about half marked isolated were reachable, so treat isolated as a reason to check not a confirmed cut-off [F7]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos, not field-verified, so uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F8].
